integrity_statement: The proof is a mathematical argument from the cited location and maximum-degree results plus an explicit degree–fringe conditional law; finite enumerations only check finite identities. No independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Logarithmic scale in probability, not a limiting size distribution
Uniform recursive trees only; children as degrees
Uses published maximum-degree and label-localization theorems
title: The first targeted cut of a random recursive tree has size \(n^{1/(2\log 2)+o_{\mathbb P}(1)}\)
